item.title: Voxtral 3, Mercury 3 and DeepInfer
item.description:
Mistral launches Voxtral 3, a voice agent stack available on EU-hosted APIs or your own infrastructure. Also: Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion model, DeepSeek's open-sourced inference engine, the EU AI Office's first enforcement requests, and Vercel's gateway data showing open-weight models at 71.5 percent of tokens.

item.title: Mistral Large 4 awaits its licence
item.description:

item.title: Argon's Pricing Cliff, Ecosia Leaves Mistral
item.description:
Google's Gemini 4 Argon is now broadly available, but its introductory API price doubles on December first. Also: Mistral Large 4 in preview, Ecosia's switch from Mistral to open models on European servers, new evidence that LLM judges are over-trusted, and the December second AI Act marking deadline.
Catch-up episode, prepared on October 21, 2026 with only the news published before 04:05 on October 19 (Paris time).
